authority_order: raw durable event with screenshot/tool provenance

durable_boundaries.requirement: flush action, result, fresh post-state, weeks/fan provenance before another week-consuming action
flush old result, then fresh new season/weeks HOME before policy re-evaluation
flush pre-batch checkpoint and estimated execution budget
flush terminal/current state and explicit resume authority

recovery_rules: Fresh state supersedes a stale summary but does not rewrite raw history.
Recovered transcript events must be stored separately and never forged into original live trace timestamps.
UNKNOWN intermediate facts remain UNKNOWN even when a later boundary is fresh-confirmed.
Persistence failure is fail-closed: do not start the next transaction until durable write succeeds.
